section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction reviews increasing rates of cosmetic surgery and research on factors associated with willingness to undergo cosmetic procedures (e.g., body image, media exposure, personality, age). It states, "The present study sought to extend this body of research..." and predicts that lower body appreciation, higher internalisation of media influence, higher BMI, and older age will be associated with greater consideration of cosmetic surgery.
section_summary.evidence_source: "The present study sought to extend this body of research by examining the association between the Consider subscale of the ACSS (which directly measures future interest and likelihood in having cosmetic surgery, rather than attitudinal dispositions about cosmetic surgery) and body appreciation, media influence, and respondentweight status and age." and "...itwas predicted that participants with less body appreciation, higher internalisation of media influence, a higher body mass index (BMI), and older age would report greater consideration of cosmetic surgery."
